messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: UX ask from a customer demo today — they want to see "per-model delta" in the console analytics table so it's obvious when a route change increased token burn. idea: add a tiny column next to model name called `delta_vs_route_default` with +/-% and a tooltip.

Nora: That would be really helpful. Is this purely UI or do we need more telemetry? We currently emit tokens and model id per event but not the 'route_default' snapshot.

Ravi: Prefer not to retroactively compute. Proposal: when route config changes routing policy (e.g., primary -> primary+compat), we store a route_version id. Telemetry events then include route_version so the console can diff per-model against the effective default on that route_version.

Emilie: route_version is sensible. This avoids ambiguity during rollouts. also helps replay. ops cost: adding route_version (string) to events increases event size slightly.

Diego: ops-bot: any quota alarms if we increase event payload?

ops-bot: current ingestion 99p event size = 1.2KB. Adding a 16-byte route_version tag expected to add ~0.02KB on avg. No quota changes required but watch 95-99p after canary.

Nora: Frontend: column should show three things: model name, delta sign (green/red), and an inline mini sparkline for last 24h. Hover shows calculation: (model_token_rate - route_default_token_rate)/route_default_token_rate. If route_default_token_rate is 0 show `—`.

Ravi: UX nuance: what if saved_query pins to an older route_version? We should surface "pinned to v123" and an action "update to latest" or "keep pinned".

Emilie: backend: store route_version on route config change. route_version can be monotonic int. Start with default null meaning pre-schema. Migrations: existing events without route_version will be grouped under "unknown" and UI treats them as previous baseline.

Diego: API surface: PATCH /routes/:id { routing: { policy: "primary,compat" }, bump_version: true } or auto-bump when routing changes. Also add endpoint GET /routes/:id/versions to fetch baseline token rates for diffing.

Nora: For saved queries, allow metadata: pinned_route_version: "123" and pinned_model: "redwood-13b". If pinned_route_version != latest show banner: "This saved query compares against an older route snapshot" with a timestamp.

Ravi: telemetry schema changes list I want in PR: add route_version, add model_variant_id, keep existing tokens fields. Also add bool `was_fallback` when model chosen was not the first preference.

Emilie: note on cardinality: model_variant_id and route_version increase distinct tag combinations. We should encode them as small ints in ingestion pipeline to reduce storage.

Diego: rollout plan: canary 1% for telemetry schema v3, then 10% after ingestion perf check, then full. Console will have feature flag `show_model_deltas` rolled out after backend is stable.

Ravi: copy for tooltip: "Delta compares this model's token rate to the route default for the selected time window and route version. Positive = more tokens than baseline."

Nora: wireframes incoming. I'll add an edge case: when saved_query uses sampling overrides we must display both sampled delta and extrapolated delta (sampled / sampling_rate). Otherwise numbers will mislead.

Emilie: yep include sampling_rate in event if overridden by saved_query. We'll add field `sampling_source` enum {route_default, saved_query_override}.

Diego: ops-bot: started canary job `telemetry-v3` on ingestion cluster. monitor: ingestion-latency, event-size-p50/95/99, mapping-errors. https://kibana.internal/ingest/telemetry-v3

Ravi: next steps: 1) Nora to post mockups, 2) Emilie to PR schema + migration notes, 3) Diego to run canary and watch ops dashboard, 4) implement saved_query metadata and UI banner. target sync in 48 hours.

Nora: will post mocks and include sticky example where route default token rate = 0 (edge).

Emilie: I'll make sure the ingestion pipeline tags route_version as compact int. Also add doc notes for operators on backfilling historic baselines (not required).

Diego: ping me when PRs are up, I'll coordinate canary window.

Ravi: thanks all. quick ask: add a unit test for delta calc with sampling and fallback flagged.

ops-bot: telemetry-v3 canary at 1% started at 2026-03-21T15:40:00Z.
